title: Heat-Related Injury

evidence.source_text: Steps to take if an HRI is suspected:

nodes.text: Cool the body as quickly as possible, then treat other conditions

evidence.source_text: Cool the body as quickly as possible, then treat other conditions.

nodes.text: Adjust cooling levels based on severity

evidence.source_text: Cooling levels will depend on severity

nodes.text: Implement proper nutrition and hydration strategies
Consider individual differences in heat tolerance and daily variations

evidence.source_text: Ability to handle heat is different between individuals and varies on a daily basis.

nodes.text: Maintain low skin temperature to allow heat transfer from the body

evidence.source_text: Maintain low skin temperature when possible, as it allows heat transfer from the body.

nodes.text: Avoid pack weights exceeding 25% of body weight

evidence.source_text: Pack weights exceeding 25% of body weight add to the demand of an activity.

nodes.text: Ensure work expectations match physical fitness levels to reduce HRI risk

evidence.source_text: Work expectations above physical fitness levels can increase risk of an HRI.
